hook.text: Human catapult, three hundred sixty meter chimney. You're Red Bull, and you have a problem.

beats.text: First, you need height. So you pick a chimney in Trbovlje, Slovenia. Three hundred sixty meters, the tallest in Europe. The perfect launch pad for a human catapult.
But nobody has ever built a human catapult this big. So DD Squad tests it for two and a half years. First over water, then six meters, then twelve.
And then it got serious. The final version is sixty meters long, built inside the chimney in about two months, with the crew working fourteen hour days.
Now you need riders crazy enough to try it. Dani Roman and Fred Fugen, with over thirty two thousand parachute jumps between them. But here's the scary part.
On November fifth, the human catapult fires them from zero to one hundred eighty kilometers per hour in two point one five seconds. Up to four point two G.
Still not enough? Dani flies over one hundred meters straight up. Two Guinness World Records for a human catapult. Then a second of zero gravity, and both parachutes open.
